topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the opening framing and learning objectives for the lecture on cancer evolution and the tumor microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic mechanisms in clonal selection
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cell-intrinsic genetic mutations and epigenetic transcriptional changes confer selective fitness advantages during clonal evolution.

topics.label: Cell of origin and cancer stem cell hierarchies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the conceptual models and experimental evidence for how normal tissue stem cell hierarchies and cell of origin dictate tumor development.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and inflammatory promotion of tumor growth
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how external environmental promoters, inflammatory signaling, and supportive stromal interactions enable cancer initiation and progression.

topics.label: Methodological approaches to studying tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic reviews the experimental, sequencing, and spatial profiling technologies used to investigate tumor evolution and cellular heterogeneity.

topics.label: Integrated multifactorial model of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesises how genetic mutations, cell-of-origin properties, and microenvironmental factors co-evolve to permit malignant outgrowth.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding closing remarks and previews the upcoming lecture topic.
